class.name: DynamicFontData
class.brief_description: Used with [DynamicFont] to describe the location of a font file.
class.description: Used with [DynamicFont] to describe the location of a vector font file for dynamic rendering at runtime.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the font is rendered with anti-aliasing. This property applies both to the main font and its outline (if it has one).
The path to the vector font file.

The font hinting mode used by FreeType. Hinting is used to adjust a font to fit a specific pixel grid. Hinting is needed to make a font crisp and readable on low resolution displays. See [enum Hinting] for available options.

constants.constant: Disables font hinting. Ensures all characters look the same at all sizes. At smaller sizes, fonts will be blurry and possibly unreadable on low resolution displays.
If available, uses the font's native hinter for vertical pixel alignment only. It uses FreeType's hinting algorithm for horizontal pixel alignment.
(Default) If available, it uses the font's native hinter. If unavailable, it will use the FreeType hinting algorithm.
Monochrome hinting. Pixels are either on or off; there is no gray-scale. Useful for creating pixel fonts when combined with [member antialiased]=[code]false[/code].
Ignores the font's native hinter and only uses FreeType's hinting algorithm.
